entries.note: The sender created the order and J&T has not collected the parcel. The scan's scanTypeName is the same label.
An import's first scan at the gateway branch, before the clearance.
The clearance at the gateway branch; the parcel moves on with the next scan.
J&T collected the parcel. After an earlier scan moved it, as an import's clearance and transit at the gateway branch, it is J&T's collection for the last mile and reads as in transit.
The courier's delivery round, the courier delivering the parcel; the code groups it with the transit labels.
J&T's problem parcel, after a delivery round that did not deliver it; the reason is in the sentence under it, which is not read.
